title: Taiwanese American Federation of N. California 北加州 台灣同鄉聯合會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Federation of N. California (TAFNC, 北加州台灣同鄉聯合會) is a regional umbrella organization serving the Taiwanese American community across Northern California, with a particular focus on the San Francisco Bay Area. It is listed as a chapter affiliate on the national Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會) website.
